items.title: Burnt out cars and shattered glass on Paris streets after protests turn to riots and looting
items.description: Around 1,800 people were arrested after nationwide protests saw outbreaks of violence and vandalism.

items.title: Oil facilities hit in deadly overnight attack on St Petersburg
items.description: At least one person was killed in the strikes, which also hit a data centre used by Russia's equivalent of Facebook.

items.title: A wave of homemade, synthetic drugs sweeps US and deepens crisis
items.description: BBC News hears from users, dealers, prison and recovery workers as the country battles with a deadly new drug epidemic.

items.title: European diplomats attacked by Israeli settlers in West Bank
items.description: The Israeli military condemns the violence but the prime minister's office says it is part of a "smear" campaign.

items.title: Several dead or injured in major fire at Canada military base
items.description: Officials have not given a cause or death toll, citing the "very active and delicate" situation at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright.

items.title: Trump waives several Russia sanctions as row with Zelensky intensifies
items.description: The US president temporarily ends many restrictions on Moscow recently passed by Congress over "national security" concerns.

items.title: Anti-government protesters battle with police in Albania
items.description: There were violent clashes between demonstrators and riot police throughout Saturday in the capital Tirana.
